top_signals.title: Kurt Campbell: US-China AI Talks Won't Limit Beijing
top_signals.summary: Former Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell says talks between Washington and Beijing on security and AI will struggle to yield binding limits due to mutual distrust. He adds substantive progress may have to wait for a potential meeting between President Trump and President Xi at APEC or the G20. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wheat Jumps After Positive Signals From Initial US-China Talks
top_signals.summary: Wheat and corn futures rose after initial US-China trade talks were described as positive by both sides, raising hopes for the leaders’ summit later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s FX Reserves Dip, Snapping the Longest Rising Streak in Over Five Years
top_signals.summary: RBI interventions in the currency market could put further pressure on reserves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: The 'robot relations' department may become reality in workplace of the future
top_signals.summary: AI, from chatbots to humanoids and automated management systems, are being widely deployed by corporations with huge repercussions for worker pay and autonomy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
